te: Progress of 3 subcommittees, the Chiang Mai highland agriculture visit, and a petition on raw milk
se: The meeting took note of the progress of 3 subcommittees, including studying the suitability of areas for agricultural estates, a joint meeting with the Royal Irrigation Department and the Land Development Department on water outside irrigation zones, and animal disease prevention and control; scheduled a highland agriculture study visit in Chiang Mai Province on 23–25 July 2026; and considered a complaint from dairy farmers turned away when selling raw milk, which the complainants say is linked to the school milk supplement programme policy
it: Progress of 3 subcommittees: agricultural estates, water outside irrigation zones, and animal disease prevention and control
Study visit on value-adding highland agriculture, Chiang Mai Province, 23–25 July 2026
Complaints: dairy farmers turned away when selling raw milk (said to be linked to the school milk policy), and a request to follow up the agencies’ work

te: Meeting 25/2569 · Committee on Agriculture and Co-operatives
Points to discuss with the Minister of Agriculture: restructuring the farm sector and integrated agro-industrial estates
se: The meeting reviewed 2 policy issues to discuss with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives: restructuring the agricultural sector for farmers’ quality of life and food security, and developing integrated agro-industrial estates. It prepared for the Senate’s 2-year performance event on 7–9 July 2026, took note of the work of 3 subcommittees (including stray dogs and rabies), scheduled the highland agriculture study visit, and considered letters on halal meat exports and promoting biochar to reduce PM 2.5
it: Issues for discussion with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives: restructuring the agricultural sector, and integrated agro-industrial estates
Senate 2th anniversary results briefing and press meeting, 7–9 July 2026
Progress of the 3 subcommittees: integrated agriculture, water outside irrigation areas, livestock and fisheries (restoring shrimp output, stray dogs and rabies)
Study visit on value-adding highland agriculture, 23–25 July 2026
Petitions: supporting halal meat exports to the Middle East and promoting biochar to reduce PM 2.5

te: Thai shrimp industry: output fell from nearly 600,000 to about 200,000–300,000 tonnes a year; the Ministry of Commerce and shrimp farmers were invited to provide information
se: The meeting invited the Permanent Secretary for Commerce and representatives of a shrimp farmers’ association to provide information. It heard that the Thai shrimp industry has continued to slow, from nearly 600,000 tonnes a year to about 200,000–300,000 tonnes a year now, with production costs still higher than in competing countries, and took note of an explanatory letter from the Royal Forest Department on resolving problems in cooperative settlement areas
it: Marine shrimp farming: the Permanent Secretary for Commerce and a shrimp farmers' association invited to give information
Letter from the Royal Forest Department: solving problems in cooperative settlement network areas

te: Preparing to meet the Minister of Agriculture, the Department of Fisheries invited to give information on the shrimp industry, and petitions from the public
se: The meeting considered issues to discuss with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives and the ministry’s executives, invited the Department of Fisheries to provide information on the Thai marine shrimp farming industry, considered complaints such as an objection to mineral exploration licences in Nakhon Nayok Province and a request for special compensation for sugarcane growers, and took note of explanatory letters from the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives and Ratchaburi Province on residents’ proposals from the Senate Meets the People project
it: Points to discuss with the Minister of Agriculture and Cooperatives and senior ministry officials
Marine shrimp farming: Department of Fisheries invited to give information on the situation

Complaints: objection to mineral exploration licences in Nakhon Nayok Province, a request for special compensation for sugarcane growers for renewable energy, and follow-up on a floodgate construction project

Explanatory letters from the Ministry of Agriculture and Cooperatives and Ratchaburi Province on proposals from the Senate Meets the People project, lower Central region (rice processing, water outside irrigation zones, cooperative law)

te: Study of the Thai marine shrimp industry begun as assigned by the Senate, and members appointed to vacant positions
se: The meeting began studying ways to address problems in the marine shrimp farming industry and to sustainably increase competitiveness in the global market, as assigned by the Senate Ad Hoc Committee on Senate Affairs, took note of the work framework of the Integrated Agricultural Networks Subcommittee, and selected senators to be proposed for appointment to vacant Committee positions under the Rules of Procedure of the Senate B.E. 2562, clause 78
it: Studying ways to address problems in the marine shrimp farming industry and to sustainably increase competitiveness in the global market (as assigned by the Senate Ad Hoc Committee on Senate Affairs)
Integrated agricultural networks subcommittee: study framework
Members appointed to vacant positions (Rules of Procedure of the Senate B.E. 2562, Rule 78)

te: First meeting under the new chair: progress of 3 subcommittees and the Senate Ethics Committee
se: At the first meeting chaired by Mr. Sountorn Chaokijka, the meeting took note of the progress of 3 subcommittees: integrated agricultural networks (such as the idea of agro-industrial estates to reduce reliance on middlemen), water management in farm areas outside irrigation zones, and quality and standards in livestock and fisheries; and assigned Miss Amorn Sribunnak, Secretary of the Committee, as the Committee’s member on the Senate Ethics Committee
it: Integrated agricultural networks subcommittee: structural problems of the farm sector and the idea of “agro-industrial estates”
Water outside irrigation zones subcommittee: the water situation for agriculture
Livestock and fisheries quality and standards subcommittee: following the situation
Miss Amorn Sribunnak, committee secretary, assigned to the Senate Ethics Committee

te: Experts provided information on the blackchin tilapia, the seminar results were summarised, and the meeting elected Mr. Sountorn Chaokijka as Committee Chair
se: Environmental and fisheries experts explained that the blackchin tilapia is highly resilient and can live in fresh, brackish and salt water. The meeting summarised the seminar of 14 May 2026 and took note of an explanatory letter from the Trang Provincial Livestock Office on beef cattle raising by community enterprises. At this meeting, Mr. Thawat Surabal resigned as Committee Chair; the meeting then elected Mr. Sountorn Chaokijka as Committee Chair, and appointed Mr. Dacha Nutalai as Fourth Vice-Chair and Mr. Chuchart Insawang as Fifth Vice-Chair
it: The spread of the blackchin tilapia: environmental and fisheries experts give information
Summary of the seminar “A New Dimension in Managing the Blackchin Tilapia: Towards Use and Added Value” (14 May 2026)
Letter from the Trang Provincial Livestock Office: beef cattle raising by community enterprises in Wang Wiset District
Election of the committee chair: Mr. Thawat Surabal resigned from the post, and the meeting elected Mr. Sountorn Chaokijka
Vice-chairs appointed: Mr. Dacha Nutalai (fourth) and Mr. Chuchart Insawang (fifth)

te: 3 draft reports: integrated beef cattle, debt of agricultural cooperatives, and food security
se: The meeting took note of progress on the seminar on managing the blackchin tilapia on 14 May 2026, and considered 3 draft study reports: breed improvement and integrated marketing strategy for beef cattle, ways to resolve the debt problems of agricultural cooperatives, and food security and safety, which holds that food security is not only about having enough food
it: Progress of the seminar “A new dimension in managing the blackchin tilapia”, 14 May 2026
Draft report on “Breeding improvement and integrated beef cattle marketing strategies to strengthen competitiveness”
Draft report on “Approaches to solving the debt problems of agricultural cooperatives”
Draft report on “Food security and food safety”

te: The blackchin tilapia in Samut Songkhram, a draft report on sustainable drought solutions, and a draft report on integrated beef cattle
se: The meeting followed up the blackchin tilapia problem in Samut Songkhram Province, inviting representatives of Amphawa Industrial and Community Education College to provide information, took note of progress on the seminar on 14 May 2026, and considered 2 draft study reports: “Systematic and Sustainable Approaches to Drought” and “Breed Improvement and Integrated Marketing Strategy Development for Beef Cattle to Increase Competitiveness”
it: Tackling the blackchin tilapia in Samut Songkhram Province (representative of Amphawa Industrial and Community Education College invited to give information)
Progress of the seminar on managing the blackchin tilapia, 14 May 2026
Draft report on “Approaches to tackling drought systematically and sustainably”
Draft report on “Breeding improvement and integrated beef cattle marketing strategies to strengthen competitiveness”

te: Hearing from Samut Songkhram fishers on the blackchin tilapia, preparing to set up 3 new subcommittees, and a summary of the study visit on southern drought relief
se: The meeting invited representatives of fishing operators, aquaculture farmers and small-scale fishers in Amphawa, Bang Khonthi and Mueang Samut Songkhram Districts to provide information on addressing and reducing the effects of the spread of the blackchin tilapia; prepared to propose 3 new subcommittees (integrated agricultural networks, water management, and livestock); and took note of the summary of the study visit on water management for drought in Nakhon Si Thammarat and Surat Thani, which will be added to the draft study report
it: Addressing the spread of the blackchin tilapia: representatives of fishers and aquaculture farmers in Samut Songkhram Province were invited to provide information
Preparing to propose 3 subcommittees: integrated agricultural networks, water management, and livestock
Summary of the visit on water management to tackle drought, Nakhon Si Thammarat and Surat Thani Provinces

te: Progress of the seminar “A new dimension in managing the blackchin tilapia”, and summary of the visit on calcium innovation from the blackchin tilapia
se: The meeting took note of progress on the seminar “A New Dimension in Managing the Blackchin Tilapia: Towards Use and Added Value” on 14 May 2026, prepared the study visit on water management in Nakhon Si Thammarat and Surat Thani, summarised the study visit to Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi, which has developed an innovation to extract bio-calcium from the blackchin tilapia following circular economy ideas, and took note of the subcommittees’ work and progress from agencies, such as a Satun community enterprise’s proposal for an integrated farming learning centre
it: Seminar “A new dimension in managing the blackchin tilapia: towards use and added value”, 14 May 2026
Preparing a study visit on water management to tackle drought, Nakhon Si Thammarat and Surat Thani Provinces, 23–25 April 2026
Summary of the visit to Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi: extracting bio-calcium from the blackchin tilapia
Progress of the subcommittees (cooperatives reviewing its draft report, and others)
Progress from agencies: Department of Agricultural Extension (a Satun community enterprise’s proposal for an integrated farming learning centre) and the Department of Livestock Development

te: Preparing the blackchin tilapia seminar on 14 May, the integrated rice report, and visits on Chumphon beef cattle and southern water
se: The meeting considered the draft programme for the seminar on the spread of the blackchin tilapia on 14 May 2026 at Parliament House, focusing on proactive management to turn the problem into an opportunity; prepared to present the report on the integrated rice production system; scheduled study visits on standard cattle raising and beef processing in Chumphon on 21–22 April and on water management for drought in Nakhon Si Thammarat and Surat Thani on 23–25 April 2026; and took note of the farm price situation
it: Draft schedule of the seminar on the spread of the blackchin tilapia, 14 May 2026, at Parliament House
Preparing to present the report on developing Thailand's integrated rice production system
Study visit on standard cattle raising and integrated beef processing, Chumphon Province, 21–22 April 2026
Study visit on water management to tackle drought, Nakhon Si Thammarat and Surat Thani Provinces, 23–25 April 2026
Farm product price situation

te: Summary of the New Zealand visit, preparing the integrated rice system report, and preparing a visit on blackchin tilapia research
se: The meeting considered the summary of the bilateral meetings and visit to New Zealand on 9–15 March 2026, took note of the cooperatives subcommittee’s work, prepared to present the report “Guidelines for Supporting, Promoting and Developing Thailand’s Integrated Rice Production System”, scheduled a study visit on research into using the blackchin tilapia at Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi and a discussion with the Department of Fisheries to prepare the seminar, and took note of progress from agencies, such as the channel lining project in Nan Province
it: Summary of the bilateral meetings and visit to New Zealand, 9–15 March 2026
Cooperatives subcommittee: key points from the discussion on cooperative policy and management
Draft report on “Guidelines for Supporting, Promoting and Developing Thailand’s Integrated Rice Production System” (Integrated Rice Subcommittee)
Study visit on research into using the blackchin tilapia, Rajamangala University of Technology Thanyaburi, Pathum Thani Province, 3 April 2026
Discussion with the Department of Fisheries to prepare the seminar on the blackchin tilapia
Progress from agencies: reinforced-concrete lining of irrigation channels in Nan Province (Regional Irrigation Office 2), and matters from the Ministry of Transport and the Department of Fisheries

te: Study report on Thai farm household debt, preparing to present it to the Senate, and following up the Satun lady's slipper orchids
se: The household debt subcommittee summarised its study report “Management of Thai Farm Household Debt” in preparation for presenting it to the Senate. The meeting took note of the cooperatives subcommittee’s schedule to meet executives of the Cooperative Promotion Department, and took note of replies from agencies, such as on conserving and researching lady’s slipper orchids in Satun Province for commercial use
it: Study report “Management of Thai farm household debt” (household debt subcommittee)
Cooperatives subcommittee: meeting with senior officials of the Cooperative Promotion Department, 25 March 2026
Replies from agencies: lady's slipper orchids in Satun Province, conservation and research for commercial use

te: Blackchin tilapia seminar “Crisis and opportunity”, fisheries problems from Pattani residents, and preparing a visit to aquaculture farms in Chachoengsao
se: The meeting considered a draft seminar project on the blackchin tilapia, “Crisis and Opportunity”, took note of the cooperatives subcommittee’s work, which invited representatives of the Cooperative Promotion Department to provide information on the ministerial regulation on types of cooperatives, took note of a reply from Pattani Province on fisheries problems raised by residents through the Senate Meets the People project, and scheduled a study visit on aquaculture farm management in Chachoengsao on 9 April 2026
it: Draft seminar project on the problems and effects of the spread of the blackchin tilapia, “Crisis and opportunity”
Cooperatives subcommittee: enforcing the ministerial regulation on types of cooperatives B.E. 2567 (Cooperative Promotion Department invited to give information)
Reply letter from Pattani Province on proposals from the Senate Meets the People project, lower South group: shortage of fresh barramundi, and support for fishing livelihoods
Study visit on aquaculture farm management, Chachoengsao Province, 9 April 2026 (using fish to treat water in shrimp ponds, disease-resistant shrimp)
